headline: Ransomware crews and AI-powered attackers race defenders to weaponize freshly disclosed flaws, as Qilin turns a Palo Alto VPN bug into initial access and poisoned web pages hijack AI coding agents.

emerging_trends.text: Ransomware operators keep skipping malware-laden email for freshly patched perimeter gear, with Qilin now breaching networks through a Palo Alto GlobalProtect authentication bypass.
emerging_trends.topic_title: Qilin Ransomware Exploits Palo Alto GlobalProtect

emerging_trends.text: Poisoned web pages and invisible on-screen text turn AI coding agents like AWS Kiro into remote-code-execution machines, making the agent itself the softest link in a developer's toolchain.
emerging_trends.topic_title: Poisoned Content Hijacks AI Coding Agents

emerging_trends.text: Defenders and attackers both race to weaponize large language models, as Google fields Gemini 3.5 Flash Cyber to patch bugs while a Russian-speaking actor wires frontier models into an offensive platform.
emerging_trends.topic_title: AI Takes Both Sides of Vulnerability Hunting

topics.title: Poisoned Content Hijacks AI Coding Agents
topics.latest_developments: Intezer and Kodem Security showed that hidden text on a web page makes AWS's agentic IDE Kiro rewrite its own configuration file and run attacker code with no approval step, which AWS has patched, while separate researchers proved invisible on-screen text can drive five open-source Android agent frameworks, including AppAgent and AppAgentX, to run commands on the host PC.
topics.summary: Attackers hide instructions in ordinary web pages and app screens that AI coding and mobile agents faithfully execute, converting a routine summarize-this-page request into remote code execution. Developers running agentic tools should restrict what the agent can write and run.

sources.title: AWS Kiro Flaw Let a Poisoned Web Page Rewrite Its Config and Run Code
Open-Source Android AI Agents Could Let Invisible Screen Text Run Code on Host PCs
A Sneaky Hacking Tool Targeting AI Infrastructure Is Lurking in Victims' Blind Spots
Cursor, Codex, Gemini CLI, Antigravity hit by sandbox escapes

topics.title: AI Takes Both Sides of Vulnerability Hunting
topics.latest_developments: Google DeepMind released Gemini 3.5 Flash Cyber, a model that discovers, validates, and patches flaws through CodeMender for governments and trusted partners, and Cisco shipped its open-weight Antares models for cheap vulnerability localization, even as Dark Reading detailed a Russian-speaking actor named Trim who stripped guardrails from frontier models and bolted them onto offensive security tools.
topics.summary: The same large language models now power vulnerability discovery for defenders and exploit development for attackers, with Google, Cisco, and Ivanti automating triage while criminal operators build jailbroken attack platforms. Security teams should weigh AI remediation gains against the accelerating offensive tooling.

sources.title: Google Launches Gemini 3.5 Flash Cyber AI to Find and Fix Software Vulnerabilities
Cisco Launches Low-Cost AI Models for Source Code Security
Hacker Turns AI Jailbreaks Into Offensive Attack Platform
Remediating Vulnerabilities With LLMs: Inside Ivanti's Automation Push

topics.title: N-Day Exploitation Windows Collapse to Hours
topics.latest_developments: Attackers exploiting the WordPress wp2shell chain, CVE-2026-63030 and CVE-2026-60137, moved past scanning to install persistent webshells and malicious plugins on compromised servers, while Defused Cyber confirmed in-the-wild remote code execution against ServiceNow AI Platform sandbox-escape flaw CVE-2026-6875, rated 9.5.
topics.summary: Public proof-of-concept code now turns disclosure into mass compromise within hours, as vendor patch diffs hand attackers a map of what to hit. Administrators must patch WordPress, ServiceNow, and SharePoint on emergency timelines and hunt for webshells.

sources.title: WordPress wp2shell Exploitation Grows as Public Exploit Fuels Mass Scanning
Critical wp2shell WordPress flaws exploited to install webshells
Exploitation of ServiceNow Vulnerability Seen Days After Disclosure
N-day is Becoming N-Hour. Patching Faster Won't Save You.

topics.title: Qilin Ransomware Exploits Palo Alto GlobalProtect
topics.latest_developments: Arctic Wolf Labs tied multiple June 2026 intrusions to Qilin, also called Agenda, exploiting Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS authentication bypass CVE-2026-0257, rated 7.8, in the GlobalProtect portal and gateway to gain a foothold before deploying ransomware.
topics.summary: Qilin runs a ransomware-as-a-service operation that now uses the patched GlobalProtect flaw as its entry point. Organizations running PAN-OS should apply the fix and audit VPN portals for compromise.

sources.title: Qilin Ransomware Attackers Exploit PAN-OS Authentication Bypass for Initial Access
Critical Palo Alto VPN bug now exploited by Qilin ransomware gang

topics.title: Trump Orders Defense Supply-Chain Mapping
topics.latest_developments: President Trump signed an executive order directing defense contractors to build end-to-end visibility into critical supply chains, covering software dependencies, foreign ownership, and cyber-related supplier risk, landing as Ars Technica reported that more than one-eighth of apps aimed at U.S. troops carry Chinese and Russian code.
topics.summary: The order pushes the defense industrial base toward full software and supplier transparency to root out hidden foreign risk. Contractors face new requirements to inventory dependencies and ownership across their supply chains.

sources.title: Trump Orders Defense Contractors to Map Software, Suppliers Across Critical Supply Chains
Apps targeted at US troops contain Chinese and Russian code

topics.title: Anubis Claims Coca-Cola Fairlife Attack
topics.latest_developments: The Anubis ransomware gang publicly claimed the attack that suspended production at the Coca-Cola Company's Fairlife dairy subsidiary and threatened to publish stolen corporate data unless Fairlife pays.
topics.summary: Anubis, a ransomware-as-a-service crew that has battered healthcare targets, halted Fairlife dairy production across the United States earlier this month and now moves to extortion by leak threat.

sources.title: Anubis ransomware claims Coca-Cola Fairlife attack, threatens data leak

business_politics.title: U.S.-Iran War Escalates, Oil Rallies
business_politics.latest_developments: President Trump vowed to strike Iran's Pickaxe Mountain nuclear site, Goldman Sachs warned crude could hit $120 a barrel if the Strait of Hormuz stays disrupted, and Kazakhstan halted oil shipments through the Caspian Pipeline Consortium terminal after Ukrainian tanker attacks.
business_politics.summary: The war between the United States and Iran has closed the Strait of Hormuz on and off for weeks and killed 18 American service members; oil futures rose a third straight session Tuesday, July 21, as Saudi tankers reversed course following Houthi threats to Red Sea shipping.

business_politics.title: Canada, U.S. to Talk to Avert 50% Tariff
business_politics.latest_developments: Prime Minister Mark Carney said he and President Trump agreed to accelerate trade talks to resolve friction and avoid the new 50% U.S. tariff Trump imposed Monday on Canadian goods.
business_politics.summary: Trump slapped an additional 50% tariff on a wide range of Canadian goods Monday, July 20, accusing Ottawa of unfair practices in autos, alcohol, and dairy; a deal in the accelerated talks would head off the levy.

sources.title: Canada's Carney Says Trump Agrees to Talks to Avert New 50% Tariff

around_town.title: Severe Storms Shutter Kennywood and Sandcastle
around_town.latest_developments: The National Weather Service issued a severe thunderstorm watch through 8 p.m. Tuesday for Allegheny, Beaver, Fayette, Greene, Washington, and Westmoreland counties, and Kennywood, Sandcastle, and Idlewild & Soak Zone closed early at 2 p.m. as damaging winds, hail, and a possible tornado approached.
around_town.summary: Two waves of strong to severe storms carrying damaging winds, heavy rain, flash flooding, and a tornado threat moved across Western Pennsylvania on Tuesday, July 21.

around_town.summary: Pittsburgh sources the tree that stands at the City-County Building each holiday season from local residents; submissions opened this week, five months before Christmas.

around_town.summary: The Deer Lakes School District, serving West Deer, East Deer, Frazer, and Fawn townships in northern Allegheny County, named Beth Huston superintendent amid changes to its administrative team.

team_usa.title: U.S. Eyes Hosting the World Cup Again in 2038
team_usa.latest_developments: With the 2026 World Cup across the United States, Canada, and Mexico now finished, the Guardian reported an American bid for the 2038 tournament is gaining traction, spurred by President Trump urging FIFA's Gianni Infantino to bring it back while he is still around.
team_usa.summary: Booming ticketing and hospitality revenue from the 2026 tournament, plus FIFA's drive to recoup lost television income, make another United States hosting run plausible for 2038.
